name: atlas-protocol
description: Local Atlas Protocol schemas, validation runtime, and validator CLI

scripts.build:all: tsx scripts/generate-types.ts && tsx scripts/generate-standalone-validators.ts && tsx scripts/export-schema-bundle.ts && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/atlas-protocol-validator.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node'
scripts.verify: tsx scripts/generate-types.ts && tsx scripts/generate-standalone-validators.ts && tsx scripts/export-schema-bundle.ts && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/atlas-protocol-validator.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && tsx --test src/**/*.test.ts
